description: Draw a matching set of 2D game assets from one description: 8 items, 8 icons, 4 character designs, 4 seamless tiles or an 8-piece UI kit. Returns a download link to the raw sheet (on a flat green or magenta key color) and the exact command that cuts it into transparent PNGs, a sprite sheet and a JSON atlas in the project. Takes 30-90 seconds. Free tier: 3 sets per day per IP address.

description.description: What the set contains, e.g. "healing potions and elixirs in glass bottles". Your own designs only: no other studios' characters, no real people.

style_reference_url.description: Optional https URL of a PNG/JPG/WebP from the game (under 4 MB). The set is drawn in that art style.

name: generate_game_assets
